decisions.bill_key: TX:Governor Abbott August 3, 2026 Data Center Audit Directive

fields.status: Governor directive signed 2026-08-03. Current legal effect and satisfaction of its audit prerequisite through 2026-11-05 are unresolved.
fields.key_provisions: Directs PUCT and ERCOT to conduct a comprehensive verification and audit of all data centers advancing through ERCOT interconnection before additional data centers are approved to move forward; noncompliant projects must be denied connection. Required information includes public financial assistance, power, water and cooling, community impacts, and ownership.
fields.end_condition: Comprehensive verification and audit is required before additional interconnection approvals; the separate denial requirement applies to noncompliant projects. The letter states no fixed end date. Satisfaction of the prerequisite through 2026-11-05 is unverified.

evidence.supports: audit_prerequisite in the dated original instrument, not proof of continuing force through cutoff.
evidence.quote:
The Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUC) and ERCOT must conduct a comprehensive

verification and audit of all data centers advancing through ERCOT’s interconnection process

before any additional data centers are approved to move forward. Any project that fails to comply

with the requirements set forth by the PUC and ERCOT, and by state law, must be denied

connection to the Texas grid.
